Repo: C:\Users\anil1\Downloads\Hackathon\TUMHackathon26. Frontend is Next.js in src/frontend/. Medium thoroughness. I need a map of the PM-Cockpit UI to plan UX improvements. Report concisely (file paths + line numbers):
1. All pages/routes (src/frontend/app or src/frontend/src/app) and the main components each renders.
2. Where the "Audit Trail" / audit / trace / provenance view is rendered (component, how it's laid out — horizontal scroll? timeline? table?).
3. Where requirement/spec detail ("Einzel-Info", detail panel/drawer of one requirement or finding) is rendered, and where any bar chart is in it (and its vertical position within the detail view).
4. Any car/vehicle/model/region/market data and any existing filters (filter bars, dropdowns, chips). What fields exist on vehicles/signals (region, model, series, market, price, cost, engineering fields like effort, components, ECU, part)?
5. Where price/cost/engineering info is or could be shown (e.g., requirement cards, scenario cards, cost estimates). Check src/shared/beispiele/ JSON examples and src/shared/API.md for which fields exist (price, cost, effort, engineering, region, model).
6. Styling approach (Tailwind? CSS modules?), and how border-radius ("rounded-*") is applied across cards — note inconsistencies (e.g., rounded-xl vs rounded-2xl vs rounded-lg on adjacent nested elements).
7. Any onboarding/tooltip/help/tour components already present.
Do not dump whole files.

content.text:
Here's the PM-Cockpit UI map. All paths below sit under `C:\Users\anil1\Downloads\Hackathon\TUMHackathon26\src\frontend\` unless I give them in full.

Three findings affect the plan more than the rest:
- **The audit trail is a vertical list of cards.** There's no horizontal scroll, timeline axis or table.
- **The only bar chart in the detail view is the score waterfall.** It's the 3rd block, below the findings and the decision panel.
- **The `rounded-*` inconsistencies don't show on screen.** `app/globals.css:49-54` sets every radius from `xs` to `2xl` to 0. Only `rounded-full` and `rounded-none` still have a visible effect.

## 1. Pages and routes (`app/`)
| Route | File | Main components |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | `app/page.tsx:29` | `HomePage` (`src/components/home/*`: Hero, CarScene, ScenarioStrip, WorkflowStrip, VoiceField, SplitSection, Preloader) |
| `/cockpit` | `app/cockpit/page.tsx:19-52` | `CockpitHero`, `LensPanel` (ask a question and the weights change), `WeightControls` (6 range sliders), `RequirementsTable` (columns Rank / Requirement / Score / Evidence, row opens the detail page). One column, no sidebar. |
| `/requirements/[id]` | `app/requirements/[id]/page.tsx:11` | `RequirementDetailPageClient` → `RequirementDetailView` |
| `/audit` | `app/audit/page.tsx:6` | `AuditPageClient` → `AuditTrail` |
| `/insights` | `app/insights/page.tsx:40-58` | Tab list: `MatrixView`, `OpportunityMap`, `TrendsList`, `GapsList` |
| `/evidence` | `app/evidence/page.tsx` | Search box, segment `<select>`, paginated evidence list with `SourceTrustBadge` |
| `/portfolio` | `app/portfolio/page.tsx` | Category × scenario matrix plus `Compare` (two scenarios side by side) |
| `/guide` | `app/guide/page.tsx:67-70` | Four `HairlineCard`s: steps, functions, evidence levels, weights |
| `/overview` | `app/overview/page.tsx` | Redirect only |
| Layout | `app/layout.tsx:27` | `ShellFrame` (SiteHeader, SiteFooter, Assistant) |

The header nav only lists Cockpit and Audit trail (`src/components/shell/SiteHeader.tsx:14-17`). Insights, Evidence and Portfolio are not in the nav.

## 2. Audit trail
- **Page:** `src/components/AuditPageClient.tsx`. It has a status pill showing whether the hash chain is valid (`:32-43`) and a scenario `<select>` (`:44-58`), then renders `<AuditTrail>` (`:62`).
- **Component:** `src/components/AuditTrail.tsx:88-123`.
  - It's a vertical stack (`space-y-4`) of `article` cards (`rounded-lg border p-4`).
  - Each card has a sentence, a meta line (`#seq · time · actor`), an `event_type` pill (`rounded-full`) and the rationale.
  - The raw payload sits in a collapsible `<details>` with `<pre overflow-auto>` (`:111-118`).
- **Reuse:** the same component appears at the very bottom of the detail page in compact form (`RequirementDetailView.tsx:127-130`).

## 3. Requirement detail ("Einzel-Info")
This is a full page, not a drawer: `src/components/RequirementDetailView.tsx`. Its wrapper (`RequirementDetailPageClient.tsx:67-104`) adds "Back to ranked list" and "Audit trail" links. Blocks from top to bottom:
1. Header, `:40-57`: rank, category and score; title; evidence and status badges; rationale; acceptance-criterion box on the right.
2. Two columns, `:59-74`: `FindingCard` list on the left, sticky `DecisionPanel` on the right (`src/components/DecisionPanel.tsx`).
3. **Bar chart:** `ScoreWaterfall` at `:76-83` (component in `src/components/ScoreWaterfall.tsx`).
   - One horizontal bar per factor (`:86-88`, `h-2.5 bg-blue-600`), 6 factors.
   - Two boxes show the final score and the score without assumptions (`:128-137`).
   - It sits below the fold, after the findings and the decision panel.
4. Assumptions and open questions, `:85-95`.
5. "More context" `<details>`, `:97-125`: robustness, business volumes, web sources, `OfferCheckBox`.
6. Decision record (`AuditTrail`), `:127-130`.

The cockpit table also has small bars: `src/components/ScoreBar.tsx`, used at `RequirementsTable.tsx:107`.

## 4. Vehicles, markets and filters
- **Scenario type** (`src/lib/api.ts:173-190`): `id`, `derivative`, `model_name`, `market`, `countries[]`, `competitors[]`, `successor_horizon`, `data_coverage`, `headline_numbers`.
- **Scenarios in the data:** F70-EU, G60-EU, G60-US, G68-CN, G70-EU (`data/processed/`). The examples folder only has G60-US (`src/shared/beispiele/views/scenarios.json`).
- **Evidence** (`api.ts:40-51`): `derivative?`, `market?`, and `meta` with `engine`, `country`, `trust`, `publisher`, `feedback_type`.
- **Signal** (`api.ts:59-71`): `segments` (`{engine:{BEV,ICE}, country:{…}, source, feedback_type}`) and `study_link`.
- **Requirement** (`api.ts:114-138`): `effort: "S"|"M"|"L"`, `horizon`, `business {volume_2025, volume_2030, growth_pct, market_share, note}`, `offer_check {status, note, option_code}`, `robustness`, `badges`.
- **Not present anywhere:** region, series, price, cost, ECU, component or part fields. I checked `api.ts`, `src/shared/API.md` and all `src/shared/beispiele` JSON.
- **Existing filters:**
  - Scenario `<select>` in the header (`SiteHeader.tsx:93-103`). It only stays on the current page for `/cockpit`, `/insights` and `/evidence` (`:19`).
  - Scenario `<select>` on the audit page.
  - Evidence page: drivetrain `<select>` (All drivetrains / BEV / PHEV / Combustion, `app/evidence/page.tsx:10, 45-54`) plus text search.
  - Insights tabs (`app/insights/page.tsx:40-50`).
  - Example-question prompts in `LensPanel` (`:12`). The cockpit has no filter chips.

## 5. Price, cost and engineering
- **Effort** exists on Requirement and in the API docs (`API.md:77, 96`) but is never displayed. Its only visible trace is the "Low effort" score factor (`ScoreWaterfall.tsx:18`).
- **Business volumes** only appear inside the collapsed "More context" section (`RequirementDetailView.tsx:104-109`). The examples have `context.json` → `sales {market, volume_2025, volume_2030, share_of_total_2030}`.
- **Option code** is shown via `OfferCheckBox` (`src/components/DetailBlocks.tsx:36`).
- **Price and cost** have no data source. Showing them would need a new backend field, or client-side mock data.
- **Places a new column or chip would fit:**
  - `RequirementsTable.tsx:69`, the column list (effort or volume could go here).
  - The detail header badges row, `RequirementDetailView.tsx:46-49`.
  - The cockpit stats, `CockpitHero.tsx:16-44`.
  - The home cards in `src/components/home/ScenarioStrip.tsx`.

## 6. Styling
- **Approach:** Tailwind v4 with `@theme` in `app/globals.css`. No CSS modules. Colour and font tokens are at `:6-23`.
- **The override:** `:26-59` remaps `slate` and `blue` to a neutral grey and the brand blue, sets `--radius-xs` through `--radius-2xl` to 0, and turns off all shadows. The comment says this was done instead of rewriting 40 files.
- **Mixed classes in the code** (visually all square):
  - `DecisionPanel.tsx`: outer `rounded-lg` (`:29`, `:117`) with `rounded-md` inside (11 uses).
